_doc: When a worker's pause is short instead of the Capitano's. ONE rule for both teams:
the TUI's throttle engine (shared/skills/throttle_engine.py) and the API harness
(agent-harness/runtime, parity/pause-rules.ts) read this file, so the same unit of
work ends in the same pause for the same reason. The Capitano's pause is the brake
against empty rounds; these are the cases where it would brake real work.
short_pause_sec: the pause when a rule applies (the ladder's lowest step: still a
checkpoint between two units, only shorter). A rule never lengthens a pause.
empty_unit: a unit that inserted no position (a duplicate, or a lead the filters
discarded) was a check of seconds, not a unit of work: the next lead waits
short_pause_sec, not the Capitano's pause. After max_streak short pauses in a row
the Capitano's pause comes back: a Scout that finds nothing new is on a dry
list, and the brake is his.
max_unit_sec (TUI only for now): the rule is for a check of SECONDS. A unit that took longer than
this was a search that spent budget and found nothing: it gets the Capitano's pause, not the
short one (0 or missing: no limit, as it was). Scouts that ran a few minutes per empty unit and
then waited 60 s were ~39 % of the usage on a night run, with the pacing gone.
keep_captains_pause (TUI only for now: the signals are the TUI's): while the team is
recovering from a freeze the Capitano's pause is a brake on the spend, not only a guard
against empty rounds, so an empty unit does not shorten it. Two signals: a freeze or a
soft pause in the last after_freeze_sec seconds (freeze_marker.py writes it), or the
pacing report saying the team burns more than over_pace_pct_h %/h above its target
(vel_team vs vel_target). An unreadable signal is no signal; a user's burn intent
(burn_intent) lifts the hold, as it lifts the floor and the ladder.
user_requests (TUI only for now): an Analista with the user's requests waiting
(db_query.USER_REQUEST_QUEUES) pauses short_pause_sec.
queued_work (TUI only for now: the queues are counted from the database): ONE rule for the roles
listed, the Analista and the Scorer. The Capitano's pause is the brake against empty rounds, and a
round with positions waiting in the role's own queue (db_query.role_queue_count: the Analista's `new`,
the Scorer's `checked` without a score, the queues next-for-analista and next-for-scorer print) is
not empty: the pause after a unit is at most pause_sec. pause_sec is 0: with positions waiting there is
NO pause, the worker goes to the next one (measured on the burst of 10/11: 1140 s of fixed 60 s pauses on
3300 s with 11-20 positions waiting in every queue, and the Scorer idle 604 s waiting for them). With the
queue empty, or one that cannot be counted, the Capitano's pause as before. It yields to the
same hold as empty_unit (keep_captains_pause: recovery after a freeze, team over its pace): then the
Capitano's pause stays, the budget is protected. The user's burn intent ("Lavora a tutta") lifts that
hold, as before. A rule never lengthens a pause.
burst_wait (TUI only for now; shared/skills/throttle_burst.py, JHT-T309): during the FIRST BURST a worker with
nothing to do waits at most cap_sec, not the Capitano's pause. Nothing to do = an Analista or a Scorer whose
queue was read and is empty (the event wake, JHT-T297, brings it forward sooner; this is the net under a lost
signal), or a Scout that has inserted nothing since the burst began (nothing wakes a Scout). It yields to the
same spend hold as the rules above, and outside the burst nothing changes. scout_after_insert: a Scout that
HAS inserted waits at most its cap_sec after each position (the first pass has its own ceiling, first_pass_cap),
unless the pause is longer than max_from_sec (set on purpose: it stays), the spend hold applies or max_suspended_sources or more sources are suspended by source_rate.py (the
sources are refusing the Scouts) or that state cannot be read: then the Capitano's pause stays (measured on the
burst of 11/11: 15 of the 16 Scout pauses were 300 s after an insert, half of the Scouts' time asleep).
